abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_description:
Test Case Title: Complete the main flow: confirm alert, search Mumbai, view graphs, toggle values and change settings
Module: GoodWeatherKM
Priority: High

Preconditions:
- The GoodWeatherKM Android app is installed and launched
- The device is connected to the internet

Test Steps:
1. Wait for the "OK" button to be visible on the initial alert.
2. Tap the "OK" button.
3. Wait for the "Wind" text to be visible.
4. Swipe down on the screen.
5. Tap the "Update" text view.
6. Tap the "Search" button.
7. Wait for the "Search location" edit text field to be visible.
8. Type "Mumbai" in the "Search location" field.
9. Wait for the "IN" option to be visible.
10. Tap the "IN" option.
11. Wait for the "Refresh location" button to be visible.
12. Tap the Navigation Drawer.
13. Wait for "Graphs" to be visible.
14. Tap "Graphs".
15. Swipe up, then swipe down on the Graphs screen.
16. Wait for "More options" to be visible and tap it.
17. Wait for "Toggle values" to be visible and tap it.
18. Tap the Navigation Drawer.
19. Wait for "Settings" to be visible and tap it.
20. Wait for "General settings" to be visible and tap it.
21. Wait for "Hide weather description" to be visible and tap its checkbox.
22. Turn ON the toggle for "Enable notifications".

Expected Result:
- The "OK" button is displayed and the alert closes after tapping it.
- The "Wind" text is displayed and the weather data updates after tapping "Update".
- The "Search location" field accepts "Mumbai" and the "IN" option is shown and can be selected.
- The "Refresh location" button is displayed after the location is selected.
- The Graphs screen opens and scrolls up and down without problems.
- The graph values are toggled after tapping "Toggle values".
- The "Hide weather description" checkbox is checked and the "Enable notifications" toggle is ON.

Test Steps:

7. Tap on the Controls tab
8. Wait for the Male option to be visible
9. Tap on the Female radio button
10. Tap on the Screens tab
11. Wait for Open Modal Sheet to be visible and tap on it
12. Wait for the Close button to be visible
13. Swipe down on the screen to dismiss the modal sheet
14. Wait for Open Detail Screen to be visible, wait 2 seconds, then tap on it
15. Wait for the Push Another Screen button to be visible and tap on it
16. Wait for the Nested Detail screen to be visible
17. Tap on the Back navigation button
18. Wait for the Detail Screen to be visible
19. Tap on the Back navigation button and wait for 2 seconds
20. Tap on the Form tab

Expected Result:
- "DemoFull" is shown in the Full Name field and "DemoFirst" in the First Name field
- The keyboard is dismissed after tapping Done
- The Clear button clears the form fields
- The Controls tab opens and the Female radio button is selected
- The modal sheet opens and is dismissed by swiping down
- The Detail Screen, then the Nested Detail screen open, and the Back buttons return to the previous screens
- The Form tab is displayed at the end
